programme.title: TAKE MY WORD FOR IT
programme.desc: TUNG (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) and KIT (KWOK HO YING, KENIX) are the best team in the Police Negotiation Cadre. Deep down, however, TUNG dislikes KIT's dominant personality. The team recruits some new blood. TUNG chooses CHLOE (MAN CHUNG HAN, ANNIE) while KIT picks KWONG (CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN), who is eloquent. CHLOE was good at her job until someone jumped off a building in front of her. Since then she has been mentally hurt. KWONG has a crush on CHLOE. He forces her to undergo psychological therapy at WU's (CHOY TSZ KIN, ELLESMERE) practice. WU is KWONG's half brother. He regrets taking her to visit WU when he learns that they are dating. KIT's marriage is in trouble. Her husband, CHUNG (CHAN HO, MOSES), is having an affair with TUNG's wife. KIT finds out that she is pregnant when she files for divorce. Meanwhile, TUNG's legs are hurt during an operation. He becomes depressed and wants to discontinue treatment. Fortunately, KIT and KWONG support and encourage him. Slowly, love sparkles between KIT and TUNG.

programme.title: Lo And Behold
programme.desc: HUNG SHU-KAN (Lau Dan) built his own logistics business from scratch and now everything is in order. The only thing on his mind is the well-being of his three daughters. His eldest daughter has moved abroad, but his second youngest daughter, HUNG YUEK-SHUI (Koni Lui), is still single. She and her little prodigy sister, HUNG SUM-YUE (Andrea So), often fight over small things, putting their father in dilemmas.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Try It? Really? & What's On Today
programme.desc: Many Hong Kong residents have been traveling north for leisure in recent years, and they've likely gained considerable experience in eating, shopping, playing, and staying. Everyone hopes to find the best value-for-money places to eat, drink, and have fun, gaining a lot of emotional value. Host Kong Mei-yee travels to different places in Guangdong Province, including Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Huizhou, Dongguan, Chaozhou, and Shantou. At each stop, she teams up with two male partners from among Chow Kalok, Chu Man-hon, Tsang Zhanwang, and Ng Yip-kwan, testing various foods as customers to see if they're worth the money, and exploring whether various attractions are worth visiting, providing Hong Kong viewers with a down-to-earth reference index.

programme.title: Global Citizens
programme.desc: In the grand trend of globalization, everyone's lives are interconnected. This eight-episode program invites eight foreign residents of Hong Kong to share the cultural characteristics of their countries. They come from Chile, Ukraine, Japan, Pakistan, the United States, Switzerland, and other countries. Each episode is divided into two parts. The first part invites guests to introduce the cultural characteristics of their own countries and, through their daily lives, to understand the extent to which they have integrated into Hong Kong life. The second part, in a talk show format, features guests and two hosts sharing their views on various social issues, including how to become a global citizen, the choices of Generation Y, working women, breaking down stereotypes, and property buying culture.

programme.title: Themis
programme.desc: At the peak of her career, High Court Acting Judge Yin Wai-chi (Charmaine Sheh) astonishingly offers to be demoted to serve as a juvenile court magistrate due to a case handled by defense counsel Ko Shuk-wah (Alice Chan). And she divorces Yau Kwong-ching (Patrick Tam), who works in the Department of Justice, because of this. Wai-chi's judicial style is highly respected by everyone in the magistrates' courts, including Chief Magistrate Hung Sze-yee (Benz Hui). Meanwhile, Magistrate Cheng Siu-man (Kalok Chow), whose aim is to become the youngest High Court judge on record, runs into obstacles on the path to promotion due to Wai-chi's arrival. Faced with a series of appalling juvenile cases, Wai-chi is on a mission to uphold justice and not allow the crooks to get off the hook or the innocent to suffer. She is determined to redeem the lives of teenagers who have gone astray!

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2021
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Shock Mystery (Sr.2)
programme.desc: Human beings are innately curious about the unknown. Some even believe that not everything in life can be explained solely by scientific or physical phenomena. Even when there appears to be an acceptable answer on the surface, it may not fully resolve all our questions. The production team of " Shock Mystery" has collected hundreds of strange and unusual cases from around the world, most of which cannot be explained from the perspectives commonly accepted by people—unless supernatural phenomena truly exist in our world! This program will introduce you to incredible mysteries that not only existed in the past but still persist today!

programme.title: Romance of A Twin Flower
programme.desc: Ji Man, who grew up in Haifang, lost her memory after falling into the water and unexpectedly became the wife of Ning Yuxuan, the Left Minister of the Imperial Court. Upon awakening, Ji Man learned she was the universally hated First Lady of the Marquis's mansion. Hoping to win Ning Yuxuan's favor, she was instead ruthlessly banished to the Repentance Pavilion. Ji Man turned her fortunes around in the Marquis's mansion by selling "Scar-Removing Cream," and later saved her husband before the Emperor, winning his favor and being granted the title of Second-Rank Imperial Lady. Ning Yuxuan brought Ji Man to Haifang to take up his post. Together, they defeated the two villains who ruled Haifang, Shen Liancheng and Wang Jinyao. Under Ning Yuxuan's governance, Haifang took on a new look, and Ji Man also opened a cosmetics shop, Haoxuetang. With the holding of the Imperial Merchants Conference, various forces vied for power, and conspiracies unfolded. Ning Yuxuan and Ji Man joined forces to defeat Prince Tan. Unexpectedly, Ji Man fell off a cliff, and Ning Yuxuan searched for her in vain, falling into a long period of longing. A year later, Haifang was hit by a flood. Ning Yuxuan and Ji Man reunited during the disaster relief efforts. After overcoming numerous hardships, they finally became a couple...

programme.title: Themis & What's On Today
programme.desc: At the peak of her career, High Court Acting Judge Yin Wai-chi (Charmaine Sheh) astonishingly offers to be demoted to serve as a juvenile court magistrate due to a case handled by defense counsel Ko Shuk-wah (Alice Chan). And she divorces Yau Kwong-ching (Patrick Tam), who works in the Department of Justice, because of this. Meanwhile, Magistrate Cheng Siu-man (Kalok Chow), whose aim is to become the youngest High Court judge on record, runs into obstacles on the path to promotion due to Wai-chi's arrival. Faced with a series of appalling juvenile cases, Wai-chi is on a mission to uphold justice and not allow the crooks to get off the hook or the innocent to suffer. She is determined to redeem the lives of teenagers who have gone astray!

programme.title: Romance of A Twin Flower
programme.desc: Ji Man, who grew up in Haifang, lost her memory after falling into the water and unexpectedly became the wife of Ning Yuxuan, the Left Minister of the Imperial Court. Upon awakening, Ji Man learned she was the universally hated First Lady of the Marquis's mansion. Hoping to win Ning Yuxuan's favor, she was instead ruthlessly banished to the Repentance Pavilion. Ji Man turned her fortunes around in the Marquis's mansion by selling "Scar-Removing Cream," and later saved her husband before the Emperor, winning his favor and being granted the title of Second-Rank Imperial Lady. Ning Yuxuan brought Ji Man to Haifang to take up his post. Together, they defeated the two villains who ruled Haifang, Shen Liancheng and Wang Jinyao. Under Ning Yuxuan's governance, Haifang took on a new look, and Ji Man also opened a cosmetics shop, Haoxuetang. With the holding of the Imperial Merchants Conference, various forces vied for power, and conspiracies unfolded. Ning Yuxuan and Ji Man joined forces to defeat Prince Tan. Unexpectedly, Ji Man fell off a cliff, and Ning Yuxuan searched for her in vain, falling into a long period of longing. A year later, Haifang was hit by a flood. Ning Yuxuan and Ji Man reunited during the disaster relief efforts. After overcoming numerous hardships, they finally became a couple...

programme.title: TAKE MY WORD FOR IT
programme.desc: TUNG (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) and KIT (KWOK HO YING, KENIX) are the best team in the Police Negotiation Cadre. Deep down, however, TUNG dislikes KIT's dominant personality. The team recruits some new blood. TUNG chooses CHLOE (MAN CHUNG HAN, ANNIE) while KIT picks KWONG (CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN), who is eloquent. CHLOE was good at her job until someone jumped off a building in front of her. Since then she has been mentally hurt. KWONG has a crush on CHLOE. He forces her to undergo psychological therapy at WU's (CHOY TSZ KIN, ELLESMERE) practice. WU is KWONG's half brother. He regrets taking her to visit WU when he learns that they are dating. KIT's marriage is in trouble. Her husband, CHUNG (CHAN HO, MOSES), is having an affair with TUNG's wife. KIT finds out that she is pregnant when she files for divorce. Meanwhile, TUNG's legs are hurt during an operation. He becomes depressed and wants to discontinue treatment. Fortunately, KIT and KWONG support and encourage him. Slowly, love sparkles between KIT and TUNG.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: On-Lie Game
programme.desc: Cyber Security & Technology Crime Bureau Senior Inspector Szeto Chung (Mat Yeung) is a mentor to and also a friend of Inspector Siu Mei-ting (Hera Chan) in the workplace. They have unraveled all kinds of phone, online and tech scams. While Szeto Chung is investigating an online dating case, he runs into his ex-girlfriend Cheung Wai (Samantha Ko) again. Love between Szeto Chung and Cheung Wai is rekindled as Cheung Wai happens to have broken up with her husband Shum Chi-ho (Stephen Wong). And then Mei-ting feels perturbed as she has mistakenly caused her family members to fall for a money scam. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.desc: The "Super Trio Series" is celebrating its 25th anniversary, and "Super Trio Master" Eric Tsang announces the show's triumphant return! Led by Chin Ka-lok, Louis Yuen, and newly joined "Super Trio Masters" Mayanne Mak, Ching Ho-Chun, and Ng Ka-Yee, each episode will feature a host of hilarious guest friends, participating in numerous laugh-out-loud games to deliver endless laughs and ensure the most enjoyable Sunday night for Hong Kong audiences, continuing to spread positive energy and happiness!

programme.title: Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4
programme.desc: " Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4" has officially launched, continuing the success of the previous three seasons and once again providing a stage for singing enthusiasts to pursue their dreams. This season expands its recruitment efforts to North America and Australia, with several TVB artists participating "masked," igniting the flame of music globally and illuminating the hearts of countless dreamers. Stephanie Che continues to host, offering her warm smile to the contestants; Maria Cordero, Chow Kwok-fung, Cheung Ka-tim, Hai-er, and Gu Ya-wei also serve as judges, providing professional feedback and encouragement to the participants. On this new season's stage, everyone will weave an even more moving chapter with music, continuing the heartfelt story of " Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4.".

programme.title: Star Weekly

programme.title: Cantopop At 50
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.title: TAKE MY WORD FOR IT
programme.desc: TUNG (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) and KIT (KWOK HO YING, KENIX) are the best team in the Police Negotiation Cadre. Deep down, however, TUNG dislikes KIT's dominant personality. The team recruits some new blood. TUNG chooses CHLOE (MAN CHUNG HAN, ANNIE) while KIT picks KWONG (CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN), who is eloquent. CHLOE was good at her job until someone jumped off a building in front of her. Since then she has been mentally hurt. KWONG has a crush on CHLOE. He forces her to undergo psychological therapy at WU's (CHOY TSZ KIN, ELLESMERE) practice. WU is KWONG's half brother. He regrets taking her to visit WU when he learns that they are dating. KIT's marriage is in trouble. Her husband, CHUNG (CHAN HO, MOSES), is having an affair with TUNG's wife. KIT finds out that she is pregnant when she files for divorce. Meanwhile, TUNG's legs are hurt during an operation. He becomes depressed and wants to discontinue treatment. Fortunately, KIT and KWONG support and encourage him. Slowly, love sparkles between KIT and TUNG.

programme.title: Lo And Behold
programme.desc: HUNG SHU-KAN (Lau Dan) built his own logistics business from scratch and now everything is in order. The only thing on his mind is the well-being of his three daughters. His eldest daughter has moved abroad, but his second youngest daughter, HUNG YUEK-SHUI (Koni Lui), is still single. She and her little prodigy sister, HUNG SUM-YUE (Andrea So), often fight over small things, putting their father in dilemmas.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Try It? Really? & What's On Today
programme.desc: Many Hong Kong residents have been traveling north for leisure in recent years, and they've likely gained considerable experience in eating, shopping, playing, and staying. Everyone hopes to find the best value-for-money places to eat, drink, and have fun, gaining a lot of emotional value. Host Kong Mei-yee travels to different places in Guangdong Province, including Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Huizhou, Dongguan, Chaozhou, and Shantou. At each stop, she teams up with two male partners from among Chow Kalok, Chu Man-hon, Tsang Zhanwang, and Ng Yip-kwan, testing various foods as customers to see if they're worth the money, and exploring whether various attractions are worth visiting, providing Hong Kong viewers with a down-to-earth reference index.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Themis
programme.desc: At the peak of her career, High Court Acting Judge Yin Wai-chi (Charmaine Sheh) astonishingly offers to be demoted to serve as a juvenile court magistrate due to a case handled by defense counsel Ko Shuk-wah (Alice Chan). And she divorces Yau Kwong-ching (Patrick Tam), who works in the Department of Justice, because of this. Wai-chi's judicial style is highly respected by everyone in the magistrates' courts, including Chief Magistrate Hung Sze-yee (Benz Hui). Meanwhile, Magistrate Cheng Siu-man (Kalok Chow), whose aim is to become the youngest High Court judge on record, runs into obstacles on the path to promotion due to Wai-chi's arrival. Faced with a series of appalling juvenile cases, Wai-chi is on a mission to uphold justice and not allow the crooks to get off the hook or the innocent to suffer. She is determined to redeem the lives of teenagers who have gone astray!

programme.title: Food Mister
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what fictional dishes in literature would taste like? The flavors of the food described by authors are left to the reader's interpretation; however, it's not entirely impossible to cook them in reality. The host invites celebrity chefs to find creative inspiration from TV series, video games, cartoons, and literary classics, discovering some of the featured dishes mentioned within them, and then, through the skillful hands of these master chefs, "recreating" these seemingly unreal dishes. Can these fantastical dishes actually be cooked? Or are they merely the creators' fantasies? The program immerses viewers in a culinary world where fantasy and reality intertwine!

programme.title: Solo Road Trip
programme.desc: Tired of checklist-style travel? Internet celebrity Liang Jiaming (Mingzai) stays true to himself, embarking on spontaneous, no-planned road trips and sharing his travel experiences from a first-person perspective. Always a solo "freesty traveler," he discovers countless moments of beauty on his own! This time, Mingzai acts as a guide on television, leading viewers on an in-depth tour of Britain! Starting in Manchester, his first city visited; then savoring the beauty of the medieval city of York; and experiencing the unique pastoral scenery of the Lake District. Moving on to Scotland and Northern Ireland, he explores towns and cities, indulging in a culinary extravaganza of British cuisine! What unforgettable experiences await him back in London?

programme.title: Romance of A Twin Flower
programme.desc: Ji Man, who grew up in Haifang, lost her memory after falling into the water and unexpectedly became the wife of Ning Yuxuan, the Left Minister of the Imperial Court. Upon awakening, Ji Man learned she was the universally hated First Lady of the Marquis's mansion. Hoping to win Ning Yuxuan's favor, she was instead ruthlessly banished to the Repentance Pavilion. Ji Man turned her fortunes around in the Marquis's mansion by selling "Scar-Removing Cream," and later saved her husband before the Emperor, winning his favor and being granted the title of Second-Rank Imperial Lady. Ning Yuxuan brought Ji Man to Haifang to take up his post. Together, they defeated the two villains who ruled Haifang, Shen Liancheng and Wang Jinyao. Under Ning Yuxuan's governance, Haifang took on a new look, and Ji Man also opened a cosmetics shop, Haoxuetang. With the holding of the Imperial Merchants Conference, various forces vied for power, and conspiracies unfolded. Ning Yuxuan and Ji Man joined forces to defeat Prince Tan. Unexpectedly, Ji Man fell off a cliff, and Ning Yuxuan searched for her in vain, falling into a long period of longing. A year later, Haifang was hit by a flood. Ning Yuxuan and Ji Man reunited during the disaster relief efforts. After overcoming numerous hardships, they finally became a couple...

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Big Big Home
programme.desc: New buildings are glamorous and stylish, saving you a lot of decorating hassles. Older homes, with a little thought, can also be given a fresh new look. Director Lai Fengqi, Taiwanese-American singer Rong Zhonghao, artist Yang Zili, music producer Chen Hongjia, and Liu Lixue, the "father of Chinese computers" from Canada, will also reveal their comfortable homes on the show.

programme.title: Clash Of Chefs
programme.desc: When "Master Ding" Li Jiading and "Third Sister" Xiao Xiuxiang, known for their blend of strength and gentleness, meet, a brand new kitchen battle is about to begin! These two star chefs will pull out all the stops, igniting a series of fierce competition! Each episode features guests who present challenges to Master Ding and Third Sister, including renowned chefs and food connoisseurs, requiring them to use the same ingredients or themes to create dishes with distinct styles, competing and sharing their culinary experiences. Guests will critique the dishes blindly, their honest palates offering unbiased judgments based solely on taste. Afterwards, the two will temporarily truce and become judges, handing over the baton to "star apprentices" Chen Wei and Tan Junyan to continue the culinary showdown!

programme.title: Romance of A Twin Flower
programme.desc: Ji Man, who grew up in Haifang, lost her memory after falling into the water and unexpectedly became the wife of Ning Yuxuan, the Left Minister of the Imperial Court. Upon awakening, Ji Man learned she was the universally hated First Lady of the Marquis's mansion. Hoping to win Ning Yuxuan's favor, she was instead ruthlessly banished to the Repentance Pavilion. Ji Man turned her fortunes around in the Marquis's mansion by selling "Scar-Removing Cream," and later saved her husband before the Emperor, winning his favor and being granted the title of Second-Rank Imperial Lady. Ning Yuxuan brought Ji Man to Haifang to take up his post. Together, they defeated the two villains who ruled Haifang, Shen Liancheng and Wang Jinyao. Under Ning Yuxuan's governance, Haifang took on a new look, and Ji Man also opened a cosmetics shop, Haoxuetang. With the holding of the Imperial Merchants Conference, various forces vied for power, and conspiracies unfolded. Ning Yuxuan and Ji Man joined forces to defeat Prince Tan. Unexpectedly, Ji Man fell off a cliff, and Ning Yuxuan searched for her in vain, falling into a long period of longing. A year later, Haifang was hit by a flood. Ning Yuxuan and Ji Man reunited during the disaster relief efforts. After overcoming numerous hardships, they finally became a couple...

However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: TAKE MY WORD FOR IT
programme.desc: TUNG (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) and KIT (KWOK HO YING, KENIX) are the best team in the Police Negotiation Cadre. Deep down, however, TUNG dislikes KIT's dominant personality. CHLOE was good at her job until someone jumped off a building in front of her. Since then she has been mentally hurt. KWONG has a crush on CHLOE. He forces her to undergo psychological therapy at WU's (CHOY TSZ KIN, ELLESMERE) practice. WU is KWONG's half brother. He regrets taking her to visit WU when he learns that they are dating. KIT's marriage is in trouble. Her husband, CHUNG (CHAN HO, MOSES), is having an affair with TUNG's wife. KIT finds out that she is pregnant when she files for divorce. Meanwhile, TUNG's legs are hurt during an operation. He becomes depressed and wants to discontinue treatment. Fortunately, KIT and KWONG support and encourage him. Slowly, love sparkles between KIT and TUNG.

programme.title: Global Citizens

Wai-chi's judicial style is highly respected by everyone in the magistrates' courts, including Chief Magistrate Hung Sze-yee (Benz Hui). Meanwhile, Magistrate Cheng Siu-man (Kalok Chow), whose aim is to become the youngest High Court judge on record, runs into obstacles on the path to promotion due to Wai-chi's arrival. Faced with a series of appalling juvenile cases, Wai-chi is on a mission to uphold justice and not allow the crooks to get off the hook or the innocent to suffer. She is determined to redeem the lives of teenagers who have gone astray!

programme.title: Time Raiders
programme.desc: The series follows the story of Wu Xie, an antique shop owner who accidentally discovers a mysterious silk manuscript. Upon closer inspection, his uncle, Wu Sanxing, finds an enigmatic map hidden within the text.

programme.title: Try It? Really?
programme.desc: Many Hong Kong residents have been traveling north for leisure in recent years, and they've likely gained considerable experience in eating, shopping, playing, and staying. Everyone hopes to find the best value-for-money places to eat, drink, and have fun, gaining a lot of emotional value. Host Kong Mei-yee travels to different places in Guangdong Province, including Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Huizhou, Dongguan, Chaozhou, and Shantou. At each stop, she teams up with two male partners from among Chow Kalok, Chu Man-hon, Tsang Zhanwang, and Ng Yip-kwan, testing various foods as customers to see if they're worth the money, and exploring whether various attractions are worth visiting, providing Hong Kong viewers with a down-to-earth reference index.

programme.title: EXTRA
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kong's entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audience—ensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Lo And Behold
programme.desc: HUNG SHU-KAN (Lau Dan) built his own logistics business from scratch and now everything is in order. The only thing on his mind is the well-being of his three daughters. His eldest daughter has moved abroad, but his second youngest daughter, HUNG YUEK-SHUI (Koni Lui), is still single. She and her little prodigy sister, HUNG SUM-YUE (Andrea So), often fight over small things, putting their father in dilemmas.

programme.title: Romance of A Twin Flower
programme.desc: Ji Man, who grew up in Haifang, lost her memory after falling into the water and unexpectedly became the wife of Ning Yuxuan, the Left Minister of the Imperial Court. Upon awakening, Ji Man learned she was the universally hated First Lady of the Marquis's mansion. Hoping to win Ning Yuxuan's favor, she was instead ruthlessly banished to the Repentance Pavilion. Ji Man turned her fortunes around in the Marquis's mansion by selling "Scar-Removing Cream," and later saved her husband before the Emperor, winning his favor and being granted the title of Second-Rank Imperial Lady. Ning Yuxuan brought Ji Man to Haifang to take up his post. Together, they defeated the two villains who ruled Haifang, Shen Liancheng and Wang Jinyao. Under Ning Yuxuan's governance, Haifang took on a new look, and Ji Man also opened a cosmetics shop, Haoxuetang. With the holding of the Imperial Merchants Conference, various forces vied for power, and conspiracies unfolded. Ning Yuxuan and Ji Man joined forces to defeat Prince Tan. Unexpectedly, Ji Man fell off a cliff, and Ning Yuxuan searched for her in vain, falling into a long period of longing. A year later, Haifang was hit by a flood. Ning Yuxuan and Ji Man reunited during the disaster relief efforts. After overcoming numerous hardships, they finally became a couple...

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Hu Bao Xun Zong
programme.desc: Spanning twenty years, the story follows Fang Kun, an archaeology student at Qinchuan University, and his mentor, Zan Maochang. After Professor Zan tragically dies during an expedition to locate a legendary lost mausoleum, Fang Kun dedicates his life to fulfilling his mentor's legacy. Returning to the field years later, Fang Kun joins forces with his former colleague Luo Qing and a dedicated police officer, Qi Dacang. Together, they lead a grassroots movement to defend ancient sites against ruthless tomb raiders and international smugglers. Based on real-life criminal cases, the drama highlights the tireless battle to preserve China's cultural history for future generations.

programme.title: Hu Bao Xun Zong
programme.desc: Spanning twenty years, the story follows Fang Kun, an archaeology student at Qinchuan University, and his mentor, Zan Maochang. After Professor Zan tragically dies during an expedition to locate a legendary lost mausoleum, Fang Kun dedicates his life to fulfilling his mentor's legacy. Returning to the field years later, Fang Kun joins forces with his former colleague Luo Qing and a dedicated police officer, Qi Dacang. Together, they lead a grassroots movement to defend ancient sites against ruthless tomb raiders and international smugglers. Based on real-life criminal cases, the drama highlights the tireless battle to preserve China's cultural history for future generations.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

Having devoted his entire life to developing soy sauce products, Chu-Tsai sincerely hopes that one of his children will follow in his footsteps and take over the family business. However, he also respects their individual passions and aspirations. Because of their fathers dream of innovation, the lives of the Chao brothers are about to change.

programme.title: New Taiwan Is Online
programme.desc: In a media landscape flooded with misinformation, this current affairs programme cuts through the noise with sharp analysis and investigative reporting. Hosted by Lee Cheng Hao, the show uncovers hidden issues and speaks up for the people, delivering clarity and accountability in every episode.

programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show. Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu & his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

Led by Detective Ye Jun, the Chinese Fox Hunt Team launches a high-stakes cross-border mission to recover the stolen assets and uncovers shocking secrets during the pursuit.

programme.title: My Blue Summer
programme.desc: Zhi has been secretly in love with Nan since she met him once as a child. After graduating high school, Zhi realizes that she and Nan are in the same university, where they get to know each other by chance and become close friends. However, Zhi is still too shy to express her love for Nan. Will this long-term crush finally turn into true love?

programme.title: Burning Blood
programme.desc: Narcotics squad members—Tai Hua, Lao Mi, Ah Feng, and Ah Tang—are involved in arresting a drug lord. However, a betrayal within the police leads to the deaths of Ah Feng and his superior, while Ah Tang vanishes. As Tai Hua and Lao Mi uncover the truth, they find themselves torn between loyalty and betrayal in their fight against the drug cartel.

programme.title: Trending Topic
programme.desc: Chen Miao, an online media editor-in-chief, wrote a popular article which has become a trending topic. This however, led indirectly to a girl's suicide. After receiving a help request, she realises that there is more to the story than meets the eye. As public opinion sways on the case, a war to speak up for the weak has begun!

programme.title: Lelio PoPo
programme.desc: Jiang Man Da (KK) and Lu Ye Chang (Luke) are the most famous and popular radio deejays. However, they have a bad attitude and ego to deal with. One day, they are being fired by their superior and ended up being shunned off by all the other major radio stations as well. Out of job and down-and-out for several months, they decided to attend a public audition for radio deejays at a new radio station. Jiang Man Da and Lu Ye Chang are surprised to see many old ladies applying for the job. It turned out that the radio station is actually looking for 2 "Ah Po" (old lady) deejays for a new show. They then disguise themselves as old ladies and got the job. Their momentum as the "PoPo" deejays builds up and that is when the fun begins.

programme.title: Project Gutenberg
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Police hunts for a counterfeiting gang led by a mastermind known as Painter. The gang is so skillful that it's almost impossible to distinguish between its counterfeit currency and real money. In an effort to find Painter's real identity, the Police recruits artist Lee Man to assist in solving the case.

programme.title: My Best Bet
programme.desc: Gambling addict Jing vows to quit after marrying anti-gambling advocate Zheng. However, wealthy gambler Ian nurses a long-held grudge against Zheng over a past humiliation and exacts revenge by taking the couple's siblings hostage. To save them, Jing breaks her vow and alongside Zheng, faces Ian in a final gamble.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hong Kong
programme.desc: This is a story of ICAC investigators fighting against rampant corruption in early 1970s' Hong Kong. A police sergeant teams up with a triad boss to make billions of dollars in bribes. As a lawyer joins his friend in ICAC to investigate their collusion and fight against corruption, the battle between the righteous and the wicked has just begun.

programme.title: The Way We Dance
programme.desc: Tofu shop girl Fleur possesses a quirky gift for hip hop and dance which she uses to becomes a supernova in the university dance crew. Meanwhile, Alan, from the Tai Chi Club has an eye for Fleur's sleight of hand and tries to recruit her into his club.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat stars as a down-on-his-luck gambler, Water, whose ex-girlfriend asked him to take care of their autistic son. As Water lives with his son, he soon finds his goal in life. When he discovers his son's talent in running, Water decides to give up his dissipated life and support his son to achieve his dream.

programme.title: The Unwavering Brotherhood
programme.desc: The revered elder of a triad gang faces succession uncertainty when his three trusted underlings—Hua, Fei, and Guo—are robbed while transporting gang money. Determined to redeem himself, Hua vows to track down the robbers. However, when Hua discovers that Fei and Guo are connected to the robbery, he must choose between loyalty and brotherhood.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the "Heartbroken Sword" style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: The Chinese Feast
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career but Adam still wants to make up and tries to move her 77 times. Things become more complicated when a Thai movie idol courts Eva. It is at this time that Eva's mother becomes very ill, and she considers marriage in order to fulfil her mother's wish. Will Adam succeed in warming Eva's heart?

programme.title: Wolf Hiding
programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer, Chen An vows to take revenge for her sister who was killed by a crime gang. Dealing with the police and the triad at the same time, a final battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A Chinese dessert shop owned by the Chang family in Kowloon City faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. Their daughter sacrifices her dream of becoming a flight attendant to help keep the family business alive, but tensions rise as she clashes with her father. Can they find a way to overcome their struggles and remain united?

programme.title: Montages of a Modern Motherhood
programme.desc: Montages of a Modern Motherhood.

programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Set 500 years before the Monkey King Wu Kong wreaks havoc in the heavenly kingdom, the movie tells the story of how Wu Kong who, unwilling to bow to his own destiny, sets out to rebel against the gods.

programme.title: Vital Signs
programme.desc: Paramedic Wang partners with Ma after being reassigned to a new station. Initially, Wang disagrees with Ma's unconventional methods, but over time, Ma helps him rediscover the true mission of a paramedic - saving every life.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: A killer and a stage actor accidentally swapped their identities at a bathhouse. The actor must complete the killer's mission while the killer thinks he is a hopeless actor after losing his memory during the accident. When the killer strives to become a successful stage actor, he also starts to recall what has happened….

programme.title: Mama's Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung stays home to take care of her husband and son after retirement. She decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol. This makes her teenage son, Jonathan, intensely jealous of Fong Ching.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: This dark comedy begins with an unidentified corpse appearing at the doorstep of a residential flat. Fearing that the corpse will turn their flats into "haunted flats", which will cause a drastic drop in the property value, the four families living on the same floor attempt to move the corpse away, embroiling themselves in chaos.

programme.title: Just 1 Day
programme.desc: Mosaic, an urban sketcher, is suffering from ALS and wants to create some fond memories as his condition worsens. When Mosaic reunites with his old classmate Angelfish, whom he has a crush on since primary school, he asks her to fulfill his one last wish by becoming his girlfriend for just one day. Will Angelfish say “yes”?

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Incredible
programme.desc: Middle-aged and retired superhero couple, Huan (Gazer Man) and Red (Aroma Woman), settles into a contented life in a remote village. They find it hard to contain their powers though, and are bored by the uneventful life. When they hear a world martial arts contest is to be held in their village, both are itching to make their long-awaited comeback!

programme.title: Go for Broke
programme.desc: A ruthless drug trafficking group has destroyed countless families due to drug addiction, including Zhang Yao's family. Vowing to take revenge, Zhang Yao teams up with Detective An to take down the drug lords. As their revenge plot unfolds, do they share a common foe or harbour personal agendas?

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Amid the recession caused by the pandemic, debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. His unconventional approach leads to unexpected success, and his attitude toward his career and life is transformed after being inspired by the respected Master Wen.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Behind the Shadows
programme.desc: Private detective Ouyang uncovers his wife's betrayal during an investigation. Reeling from the shock, he abandons a missing person case. Soon after, the missing person turns up dead. Inspector Chen suspects a serial killer may be at large. Now drawn back into the case, Ouyang must use his skills to stop the killer before another life is taken.

programme.title: Fox Hunt
programme.desc: Adapted from true events, Fraudster Dai swindled countless victims across China before vanishing without a trace. Seven years later, he resurfaces in Paris. Led by Detective Ye Jun, the Chinese Fox Hunt Team launches a high-stakes cross-border mission to recover the stolen assets and uncovers shocking secrets during the pursuit.

programme.title: Peg O' My Heart
programme.desc: Psychiatrist Dr. Man begins treating night-shift taxi driver Choi, who is afraid to sleep and can no longer distinguish dreams from reality. During therapy, Dr. Man becomes haunted by his own disturbing and perplexing dreams. Are these night terrors the result of repressed memories, or the price of uncovering the ghosts hidden in Choi's past?

programme.title: The Ex-files 4: Marriage Plan
programme.desc: Two brothers, Meng Yun and Yu Fei, are of marriageable age and are facing challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, while Fei and his girlfriend opt for a “marriage cooling-off period” to tackle marriage issues.

programme.title: The Goldfinger
programme.desc: Inspired by Hong Kong's biggest financial scandal in the 1980s, this is a rags to riches story about Ching Yat Yin who is chairman of a listed company. With Ching's wealth and influence on the rise, ICAC senior investigator Lau Kai Yuen is determined to investigate the case, even if it means spending 15 years in pursuit of the truth.

programme.title: An Abandoned Team
programme.desc: Uncle Jia is bad-tempered and lives alone. His forced retirement, failed marriage and strained relationship with his daughter have left him in despair, prompting him to consider ending his life. Fortunately, he is rescued by a stray dog and an animal welfare volunteer, allowing him to rediscover his purpose in life.

programme.title: Social Distancing
programme.desc: Cherry is a young girl addicted to the internet. After seeing a warning video about an “e-ghost” on YouTube, she begins to encounter many mysterious incidents, and the “e-ghost” also takes control of her family. Cherry must face her unbearable past in order to get out of this horrifying paranormal world...

programme.title: The Hedgehog
programme.desc: Wang's odd behaviour and quirky ideas make him a social outcast. His teenage nephew Zhou, who is ashamed of his stutter, becomes Wang's only friend. Together, these misfits challenge traditional family expectations and social misunderstandings, supporting and inspiring each other as they seek their own paths in life.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A Master fortune teller predicts that Tung, a born psychopath, will be imprisoned for murder and tries to change his fate. A veteran detective believes Tung is a psychopathic serial killer after witnessing him kill a cat, and pursues him relentlessly. Can the Master change Tung's mad fate?

programme.title: As It Burns
programme.desc: Detective Wei investigates the death of Yan Zhen in an explosion which seems more than an accident to him. Wei then finds out that Yan Zhen looks a lot like Yin, the girlfriend of Yan Zhen's childhood friend Lu, and uncovers a tangled web of deceit leading to surprising revelations when he merges details from the past and the present.

programme.title: Last Song For You
programme.desc: That summer, young Xia and Su bonded over their love of music, wondering how far this love could take them. Years later, musician Su unexpectedly reunites with his first love, Xia, in a hospital during their darkest hours. Seeing his inner struggle, the ailing Xia sends Su on a final journey—her parting gift to reignite his life.

programme.title: Prosecutor, The
programme.desc: Based on a true case, young Ma Jia Jie pleads guilty to drug trafficking in exchange for a lighter sentence, as coerced by his defense lawyer. Huo Zi Hao, a former cop turned prosecutor, believes in his innocence and launches an investigation. Risking his life and career, Huo is determined to uncover the real perpetrator.

programme.title: 44th Hong Kong Film Awards Red Carpet, The
programme.desc: Stars and celebrities hit the red carpet ahead of the Awards Ceremony, showing off their best and brightest looks for one of Hong Kong's biggest nights. Follow our live coverage as the superstars deliver their glamourous styles!

programme.title: The 44th Hong Kong Film Awards
programme.desc: Celestial Movies proudly brings you the live coverage of the 44th Hong Kong Film Awards. Stay tuned and support Hong Kong films!

programme.title: I Did It My Way
programme.desc: As the secretive, complex world of online drug trafficking increasingly targets Hong Kong, the police launches a risky and top-secret sting operation to bring down one of the most notorious drug lords in Asia.

programme.title: Don't Forget I Love You
programme.desc: Lu Yao suffers from amnesia and forgets about everything that happens yesterday when he wakes up the next day. When Lu Yao meets psychotherapist Xing Yue, they fall in love despite knowing they have no future together, and are determined to love each other no matter what happens...

programme.title: Wild City
programme.desc: A cop-turned-bar-owner befriends a drunken woman at closing hours and finds himself pursued by her former lover and the thugs he employs. The chase turns deadly when the bar owner's deadbeat brother and a suitcase full of cash enter the picture.

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: The Invisible Guest
programme.desc: Young and beautiful entrepreneur Joanna is a prime suspect in a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. She pays off a police officer to prove her innocence. During the investigation, they discover another murder case involving Joanna and her lover, and eventually reveals the truth.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat stars as a down-on-his-luck gambler, Water, whose ex-girlfriend asked him to take care of their autistic son. As Water lives with his son, he soon finds his goal in life. When he discovers his son's talent in running, Water decides to give up his dissipated life and support his son to achieve his dream.

programme.title: The Moon Thieves
programme.desc: A crooked watch dealer assembles a daring crew - a thief, an explosive expert, a lock breaker and a watch connoisseur - to steal three luxury watches in Tokyo. Their mission takes an unexpected turn when they discover the legendary 'Moonwatch.' Pursued by the yakuza, the team must unite to navigate the chaos and pull off their high-stakes heist.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: An emergency occurs on an offshore drilling rig that would cause it to capsize and sink. The Emergency Response Unit races against the clock in a chopper rescue mission amidst dangerous explosions and fire. Captain Gao Qian must work seamlessly with his chopper pilot Zhao Cheng to rescue survivors using the most maverick and dangerous tactics.

programme.title: Lelio PoPo
programme.desc: Jiang Man Da (KK) and Lu Ye Chang (Luke) are the most famous and popular radio deejays. However, they have a bad attitude and ego to deal with.
